content: Letters in other MSS: (1) a letter to Amīrzāda Bāysunghur in microfilm 227/4 (Tehran University); (2) a letter from Amīr Riżā Kiyā to Ibn Turka in MS Malik 4029/6 and MS Revan Köşkü 2024 (Süleymaniye); (3) Ibn Turka's reply to it in MS Malik 4029/6 and microfilm 227/6. MK could not consult them; he supposes two of the three duplicate letters already in the Munshaʾāt-i Turka.
